name: Windows and daylight raise vitality and sleep quality
claim: Office workers with windows had higher vitality scores and better sleep than workers in windowless offices, and they got more daylight.
caveat: A small pilot that was not random, in one US workplace; it measures health and sleep, with vitality as the nearest emotion term.

sources.title: Boubekri et al. 2014, Impact of windows and daylight exposure on overall health and sleep quality of office workers, Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine 10(6)
